title: When the Contact Wakes Again
author: Zephyrine Crane
blurb: Juniper Amberdale, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
